title: The Knight's Quest

pages.text: Sir Knight lived in a castle high on a hill.
pages.scene: A noble knight standing proudly in front of a tall stone castle on a green hilltop at dawn.

pages.text: He knew something was wrong in the kingdom that night.
pages.scene: The knight looking worried, gazing out a castle window at the darkening sky.

pages.text: A sign had been written on the old stone wall.
pages.scene: The knight examining strange writing carved into an ancient castle wall by torchlight.

pages.text: The knight could not read the design on the sign.
pages.scene: Close-up of mysterious symbols and patterns etched into stone, the knight puzzled.

pages.text: He wrapped his sword tight and set off at night.
pages.scene: The knight wrapping his sword in cloth and preparing to leave the castle gates.

pages.text: Through the dark forest, he saw a bright light.
pages.scene: The knight on horseback riding through a misty forest, a glowing light visible ahead.

pages.text: A gnome sat by a fire, knitting a lamb from yarn.
pages.scene: A small cheerful gnome sitting by a campfire, knitting a woolen lamb toy.

pages.text: The knight knocked on a tree and said hello.
pages.scene: The knight politely knocking on a large tree trunk near the gnome's camp.

pages.text: The gnome knew the answer to the knight's riddle.
pages.scene: The wise gnome nodding knowingly, gesturing as if explaining something important.

pages.text: He wrote the words down with his small thumb.
pages.scene: The gnome writing carefully on parchment, using his thumb to hold the paper steady.

pages.text: The writing said to climb the highest mountain right away.
pages.scene: The knight reading the parchment, a tall mountain visible through the trees.

pages.text: The knight thought this might be hard but not wrong.
pages.scene: The knight looking determined, gazing up at the steep mountain path ahead.

pages.text: He climbed through the night until the light came.
pages.scene: The knight climbing rocky terrain in darkness, first rays of sunrise appearing.

pages.text: At the top, he saw eight knights standing in a ring.
pages.scene: Eight armored knights standing in a circle on the mountain summit at dawn.

pages.text: They knew he would come and had brought him a knife.
pages.scene: The knights presenting an ornate ceremonial knife to the arriving hero.

pages.text: The knife could cut through any knot in the land.
pages.scene: The magical knife glowing with power, intricate patterns on its blade.

pages.text: The knight wrapped the gift and bowed his knee.
pages.scene: The knight kneeling respectfully, carefully wrapping the knife in fine cloth.

pages.text: He knew enough now to save the kingdom from wrong.
pages.scene: The knight standing tall with newfound confidence, kingdom visible below.

pages.text: The sign on the wall had shown him the right path.
pages.scene: The knight returning to the castle, villagers cheering his arrival.

pages.text: And the knight wrote his story for all to know.
pages.scene: The knight at a desk, writing in a large book by candlelight, a peaceful scene.

reference_prompt:
A 9-panel reference sheet for children's book illustration style.
Style: Medieval fantasy illustration, castle and forest settings, noble knights, warm golden lighting
Mood: exciting, imaginative, engaging

The 9 panels arranged in a 3x3 grid showing:
Panel 1: A noble knight standing proudly in front of a tall stone castle on a green hilltop at dawn.
Panel 2: The knight looking worried, gazing out a castle window at the darkening sky.
Panel 3: The knight examining strange writing carved into an ancient castle wall by torchlight.
Panel 4: Close-up of mysterious symbols and patterns etched into stone, the knight puzzled.
Panel 5: The knight wrapping his sword in cloth and preparing to leave the castle gates.
Panel 6: The knight on horseback riding through a misty forest, a glowing light visible ahead.
Panel 7: A small cheerful gnome sitting by a campfire, knitting a woolen lamb toy.
Panel 8: The knight politely knocking on a large tree trunk near the gnome's camp.
Panel 9: The wise gnome nodding knowingly, gesturing as if explaining something important.

Consistent art style across all panels, suitable for children's picture book illustration. Each panel is a square vignette showing a key moment or character.

IMPORTANT: Minimize text in panels. Focus on visual style, characters, colors, and mood. No title text.
